tasks.title: Council approvals left unexecuted by a broker outage must expire, not execute late: max-age guard and stale sweep in the autonomous execution poller
tasks.summary: Deployed and re-verified live by the autonomous cycle. tasks.title: Protective-stop coverage: a position counts as protected only when its broker stop covers the booked quantity; the reconciler replaces an under-sized or dead stop sized to the book
tasks.summary: Deployed and re-verified live by the autonomous cycle. A position is now reported as protected only when its resting broker stop covers the booked share count, read from the live broker-order projection; both the risk and positions APIs expose the coverage state and the risk summary counts uncovered positions. The reconciler now cancels an under-sized or dead protective stop, waits for the cancel to settle at the broker, and re-places one sized to the book, and an equity stop is never sized by the broker's available quantity (a crypto fee rule). A second defect found in review was closed with it: a cancelled stop's submit intent never became terminal because the broker's cancel echoes no body, so a replacement for the same position would have been refused as a replay. On deploy the first scheduled reconcile tick replaced the under-sized equity stop with a full-size one through the normal code path, with the broker showing exactly one resting stop afterwards. Twenty-one new tests red then green, full backend suite green, real-money bolt ten of ten on every run, PAPER gate unchanged.
tasks.next_action: Watch subsequent reconcile ticks stay quiet (no resize) and the next partial-fill entry get a full-size stop; the broker-rejection labelling and poller fail-loud missions remain open.

tasks.title: Equity close sizing: a manual, agent or auto-flatten close of an equity position goes to the broker for the booked quantity and waits for the protective-stop cancel to settle, instead of shrinking to the broker's available quantity (a crypto fee rule) and orphaning the remainder
tasks.summary: Deployed and re-verified live by the autonomous cycle. The single gated close path no longer shrinks an equity close to the broker's available quantity (a figure reduced by every order resting on the symbol, which is what left part of a position at the broker as an orphan). The available-quantity haircut now applies to crypto fee dust only; for every other asset class the close waits, bounded and fail-soft, for the protective-stop cancel to settle at the broker and then goes out for the requested quantity, never sized down. Six new specs through the real broker gateway were red then green, the full backend suite passed, the real-money bolt held ten of ten on every run, and the PAPER gate was unchanged before and after the deploy. tasks.summary: Audited and closed by the autonomous trading-lane cycle. tasks.title: Rejected-close booking: a close the broker authoritatively rejects, or that returns no broker order id, keeps the ledger row open and returns a structured recoverable error instead of booking the position flat while the broker still holds it; the monitoring auto-flatten retries on the next tick
tasks.summary: Deployed and re-verified by the autonomous cycle. The single gated close path no longer books a position closed when the broker authoritatively rejects the close leg or returns no order id: the ledger row stays open and untouched, only the already-cancelled protective stop is recorded as cleared so the reconciler re-protects it, and the manual close route and the monitoring override return a structured recoverable error instead of a false success. The auto-flatten engine treats any unconfirmed close as not flattened and retries with a geometric backoff capped at one hour, so a position is never left on a resolved, unmonitored rule and a persistently refused close never storms the broker. Ten new specs through the real broker gateway were red then green, the full backend suite passed, the real-money bolt held ten of ten on every run, and the PAPER gate was unchanged before and after the deploy. tasks.summary: Shipped, deployed and observed live by the autonomous trading-lane cycle. The exit resolver gained a bounded once-daily slow pass with the window widened to the next own entry and exact-quantity-only acceptance, and the close path's own order ids now join the attribution guard. Thirteen specs were red then green, the full backend suite passed, the real-money bolt held ten of ten on every run, and the PAPER gate was unchanged. tasks.title: Operations console polling consolidation: the console shell and its overview, trading desk and crypto panels each polled the aggregator for the same status and gate facts on their own timers, kept polling while hidden, and let a slow response overlap the next request; the aggregator also probed the same model endpoint twice per status call. Consolidate into one shared, visibility-aware poll with a bounded cache, abort superseded requests, and share the model probe result.
tasks.summary: Shipped and observed live by the 2026-10-01 trading-lane cycle 14. The console shell, overview, trading desk and observe station now read status, gate and infrastructure facts through one shared, visibility-aware poll per fact: one request per fact every fifteen seconds for the whole page instead of two or three independent timers, no polling while the tab is hidden with a single refresh on return, no request stacking behind a slow response, and the outstanding request is cancelled when the last reader leaves. The generic panel poll used by the crypto views runs on the same store.
